items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I knew a guy they called Raymond Dorris.

ctx.x: No, I wouldn't attend the band. We'd be in two altos. Oh, I had Moehead's son was playing Clienthead on his motorboat. His son was on Clienthead and his youngest son was on the drummer, Paul Moehead was the drummer of the band. Then we had an old Spanish brother from Narn and Delacroix, and they called Ham. His name was Raymond, he was the bass player in the band.
His first name or his last name was Raymond?

items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I worked with them on Goodwild.

ctx.x: His first name was Raymond, but I can't tell you that Spanish name he had. He was from Delacroix, somewhere around there.
They got so many names, Nunez and Malaria and Garcia, you can't remember Mariah. That's right.
That's right. That's right. I worked with them on Goodwild. We used to go around Delacroix, you know.
